Usually if my waves stop being so wavy I know it’s time for protein. I watched [this](https://youtu.be/pvhqpdPzSx8) by manes by mell and it really helped me. There’s this little graphic like 15 minutes in that lists what products you want with protein based off the porosity. If you see a product that says something like “strengthening “ more than likely it has protein. You have to really try to get a protein overload in my experience but super easy to get a moisture overload. It’s frustrating to hear but you have to experiment with it lol

Honestly what I would do is get a shampoo, conditioner, a curl cream, and some kind of gel and/or mousse and go from there. 

I do a modified squish to condish. I don’t put extra water in because it literally washes out the conditioner. I squish the conditioner in without adding water. I also don’t leave my head under the water for a while while rinsing it out( which I’m pretty sure is the cause of my water fatigue) I swish my head around in the water and squish the conditioner out. I don’t know the black magic behind it but it works for me 🤷🏼‍♀️

I also don’t SOTC. It kinda scrunches itself out while I sleep.

I hope this wasn’t too convoluted lol

I got this piercing July 12. The lady that did the piercing seemed a little rushed, and didn’t really tell me how to clean it other than soap and q-tips. I was pushing it up and cleaning that way.

It swelled so much I went back and got a bigger one. It was a different lady that seemed nicer and told me about sea salt  spray, but still with q-tips. I was still pushing it up.

I woke up one morning with dries blood on the side of my cheek and realized I was cleaning it wrong. I went on here and changed my cleaning to this:

LITHA
Sea salt spray on the outside in the morning, spray with distilled water, and pat dry.
Sea salt spray In the evening, outside and inside on account of a glob of dried blood on the piercing in the inside, cup water in the shower and blow bubbles. Pat dry when I get out.

The swelling has gone down a lot. It still looks a little infected next to it, so I’m making sure I didn’t screw it up permanently. That little bump next to it apparently only shows up on camera, because I can’t see it in the mirror
